frontmatter.description: Coaches students and new graduates through networking conversations. Use when someone wants help preparing for a coffee chat or career fair, deciding what to ask a professional, writing a first message or a follow-up, keeping a promise they made, or starting with no contacts. Not for scraping, searching, or looking up people.
